summary.note: No live corridor FAILED. Three ran and passed; three were skipped because a required Layer 2 seam is not passing. Per the Layer 3 contract a skipped corridor is not a pass, so the layer is partial, never pass.

provenance.fresh_run: ci_evidence was produced by a NEW chain, not by reusing Layer 2 artifacts, so same-run identity is genuinely demonstrated rather than assumed.
provenance.shared_artifact: assurance_harness consumed the same fresh observation, so the two passing corridors compose on one artifact.
provenance.zero_findings_caveat: The FindingBundle again carries 0 findings - a real semgrep 1.176.1 scan of l9-pr-repair/src returned none. Continuity, admission and authority are proven; a non-zero finding has still never traversed the organism.

corrections: A first identity check compared the observation's artifact digest to sha256 of the bundle FILE and reported a mismatch. The SDK digests the bundle's CANONICAL form (bundle.canonical_digest()), so the check was wrong, not the SDK. Verified with the SDK's own function it matches exactly. ci_evidence was not failed on a defect in the checker.

failures.summary: Required Layer 2 seam resolver_to_intelligence FAILED on a real defect: l9-ci-debt-resolver forwards Authorization across GitHub's cross-host redirect to blob storage, so job-log acquisition 401s. A fix is open as Quantum-L9/l9-ci-debt-resolver#52 (green, unmerged). This corridor is SKIPPED, not forced: composing it would require a hand-authored feedback event, which the contract forbids as proof.

Required Layer 2 seam intelligence_to_lsp is partial: the Intelligence producer chain ran end to end but the publication gate fail-closed with 'no promotion-eligible candidates' on a corpus built from a real 0-finding SDK bundle. No Intelligence-produced defense pack exists to feed the LSP, and a hand-authored pack would not prove the seam.

Required Layer 2 seam pr_repair_standalone is partial: ingest-review of a REAL review event (l9-ci-core PR #148) returned HTTP 403 from api.github.com/graphql on this surface. The dry-run safety properties were proven in Layer 2 using the repository's own example payload, but the live review->payload path is unproven, so the corridor is not composed.
